data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 4.8m (2014 deficit of GBP 1m). The surplus is primarily driven by reserve releases on the 2013 and prior year of account due to better than expected claims experience in the marine and energy classes of business.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve releases on 2013 and prior years of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserve releases due to better than expected claims experience in the marine and energy classes of business leading to an overall surplus reported for 2015

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 gross claims outstanding were GBP 71.636m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development table the aggregate prior-year development (excluding the two most recent underwriting years) is a net release of approximately GBP 2.28m. The Managing Agent's narrative notes an overall surplus of GBP 4.8m in 2015, driven by reserve releases on the 2013 and prior years predominantly in the Marine and Energy classes due to better-than-expected claims experience. The triangle-based calculation and the management narrative differ in magnitude but both indicate favourable prior-year development concentrated in marine and energy.
raw_causal_phrases: overall surplus of GBP 4.8m (2014 deficit of GBP 1m)
reserve releases on the 2013 and prior year of account
better than expected claims experience in the marine and energy classes of business
surplus is primarily driven by reserve releases

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Provisions note (page 22). Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development table (page 33) using the triangle diagonal method (excluded 2014 and 2015 as per methodology). The Managing Agent narrative cites reserve releases totalling GBP 4.8m driven by 2013 & prior years (which is larger than the triangle-derived aggregate release of ~GBP 2.28m) - both figures are reported above (triangle used for the prior_year_development_gbp_m field). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision (gross)' was presented separately in the notes; RITC was not evident. Some LOB-specific movement amounts are not disclosed, so LOB impacts are inferred from narrative.
